# HisabIQ

<!-- impeccable:product-schema 1 -->

## Platform
web

## Users
Bangladeshi small and medium shop owners and staff, including people with limited software experience.

## Product Purpose
Run sales, purchases, inventory, dues and finance in one simple bilingual ERP. Reports help owners decide what to buy, collect, price and pay.

## Capabilities and Constraints
React/TypeScript/Vite UI. Current in-browser preview records are not authenticated backend accounting. Reports default to the business overview, as selected by the user. Medium ৳399 and Premium ৳599 share reports; attachments are Premium-only. Counter Pack is ৳199; trial is 15 days followed by limited Basic. Seats, devices and storage remain undecided.

## Brand Commitments
Reuse the actual HisabIQ/Magic Patterns components and tokens, 36px controls, Bangla/English language settings, light/dark themes and proportional digits. No unrelated redesign.

## Evidence on Hand
Existing ERP source and the user's Magic Patterns export; reporting roadmap in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-24-report-workspace-design.md. UI records are demonstrations, not customer evidence.

## Product Principles
- KISS: decisions before configuration.
- Preserve source records and historical units/costs.
- Show unavailable data honestly.
- Complete common actions within the current context.

## Accessibility & Inclusion
Keyboard operation, visible labels and focus, compact responsive layout and Bangla/English/bilingual copy.
